hooks.text: 桌面母亲角色会跟随鼠标注视，并支持拖动、缩放与双屏切换
hooks.excerpt: The character's gaze will follow the movement of your mouse. -Supports character dragging (left mouse button) and zooming in and out (using the mouse wheel during dragging), but please do not block mother from watching TV. -You can switch the screen where the character is located in a dual-screen situation
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从游戏内母亲处学习日语、英美英语、粤语、闽南语等多种语言
hooks.excerpt: You will learn dozen of languages from your mother-in-game: Japanese, British English, American English, Cantonese, Minnan, Northeastern, Shanghainese and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次打开游戏都有机会遇到特殊母亲，例如日本黑道母亲
hooks.excerpt: When you open the game, there is a chance that a mysterious mother will appear, such as a Japanese Yakuza mother.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
